defects.description: Canary clustering: canary_section builds the cid->event_group map from fills only, so every terminal maker order on a market with no fill gets cluster = cid. On smoke_v2: 372 rows, 11 'clusters', 10 of them bare cids that likely share crypto-term@<end> groups. This inflates the independent-cluster count and narrows the canary PI once a live journal exists.
defects.fix_hint: Also map cid->cluster from cum['universe_checkpoint'] (field 'cluster'), or crypto-term@end_ms where known, before falling back to cid.

defects.description: build_rows: when a position has no BUY fills (SELL-only), entry_price falls back to the first fill's price instead of the sell VWAP, so CLV and fee_per_share for such positions use a non-VWAP entry. Ladder fills are BUYs today, so the impact is latent.
defects.fix_hint: Track sold size and proceeds and use proceeds/sold as entry for net-short positions.
